description: Source code for the QpackEncoder class, implementing header compression logic for QUIC protocol, including encoding headers, managing dynamic table capacity, and handling stream events.

classes.name: QpackEncoder
classes.description: Implements header compression and dynamic table management for QUIC's QPACK.

methods.name: EncodeIndexedHeaderField
methods.description: Encodes an indexed header field, adding to referred indices if dynamic.

methods.name: EncodeLiteralHeaderFieldWithNameReference
methods.description: Encodes a header with a name reference, adding to referred indices if dynamic.

methods.name: EncodeLiteralHeaderField
methods.description: Encodes a header as literal name and value.

methods.name: FirstPassEncode
methods.description: Performs the first pass of header encoding, producing representations and managing dynamic table references.

methods.name: SecondPassEncode
methods.description: Encodes header representations into a header block with prefix and relative indices.

methods.name: EncodeHeaderList
methods.description: Encodes a header list into a header block, managing dynamic table and stream instructions.

methods.name: SetMaximumDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the dynamic table.

methods.name: SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Updates the dynamic table capacity and sends instruction.

methods.name: SetMaximumBlockedStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of blocked streams allowed.

methods.name: OnInsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Handles insert count increment events, checking for errors.

methods.name: OnHeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of header blocks for streams.

methods.name: OnErrorDetected
methods.description: Handles errors detected during encoding or stream processing.
